features.title: Lighting

features.name: Light visibility memory
features.what: hidden lights stop taking samples.
features.title: Lighting

features.name: Radiance cache
features.what: bounces end on cached light.
features.title: Lighting

features.name: Transmission bounces
features.what: glass, ice and water get their own bounce budget; matches 6 bounces in about 70% of the time, so icicles under an eave no longer go dark at the default 3.
features.title: Lighting

features.name: Light reuse
features.what: ReSTIR DI reuses light samples across pixels and frames.
features.title: Lighting

features.name: Indirect light reuse
features.what: ReSTIR GI; rooms and shade lit by bounced light are far less noisy at the same samples.
features.title: Lighting

features.name: Back lighting
features.what: light through leaves, paper and curtains, with coloured shadows; back light texture.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Transmission
features.what: thin glass, tinted and blurred by roughness, with tinted shadows; transmission texture; `TRANSMISSION` in shaders; glTF `KHR_materials_transmission`.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Raster refraction through solids
features.what: raster refraction leaves a solid through its far side, not just the front face.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Clearcoat
features.what: matches raster, with traced coat reflections; coat texture.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Subsurface scattering
features.what: random walk inside closed meshes; skin, wax and marble soften and thin parts glow when backlit.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Wet surfaces
features.what: porous surfaces darken and turn glossier as the weather map gets wet, raster and path traced; `get_wetness_shader_code()` for ShaderMaterials.
features.title: Materials

features.name: Histogram metering
features.what: lamps in view no longer darken the scene.
features.title: Exposure

features.name: Dark-scene key
features.what: night stays night.
features.title: Exposure

features.name: Pixel antialiasing
features.what: when Ray Reconstruction is off: samples after the first spread over the pixel (R2 sequence), so sub-pixel detail antialiases instead of sparkling.
features.title: DLSS Ray Reconstruction

features.name: Mountain generation
features.what: raises ranges from an uplift map, Path3D ranges and noise, then erodes them to equilibrium with stream power erosion; branching gullies come from an erosion filter computed per point, so tiles join exactly; on crests gullies keep part of their depth and a ridged noise adds irregular pinnacles; the same for a seed; writes into Terrain3D or a HeightMapShape3D.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Terrain guides
features.what: paths drawn under the generator raise ridges, cut valleys and place rock bars, read before erosion. With `guide_preview`, a 4x coarser run follows a guide in the editor as it is drawn.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Coast and beach guides
features.what: draw a bay, a shore or an island, with a wandering shoreline that rivers run into, and set where its beaches go and how wide.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Touch-ups
features.what: height brushes reshape the generated ground and lakes and rivers re-solve around them, so a raised dam backs up a lake and a dug hollow holds a pond.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Coarse-to-fine erosion
features.what: about 3.7 times faster at 4 m cells, with the same relief.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Tile erosion
features.what: droplet hydraulic and thermal erosion in seamless overlapping tiles.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Material detail
features.what: erosion detail below the vertex spacing in the terrain material; path tracing keeps it.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Rock layers and waterfalls
features.what: hard and soft bands that rivers cut into caprock waterfalls.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Glacial erosion
features.what: ice ages alternate with the rivers and carve troughs, cirques and basins that become lakes. With rock quality varied (`glacial_rock_variation`, `glacial_rock_scale`; 0 is even rock) the ice digs its own basins and bars, so tarns and chains of lakes form with no markers. Glaciers from beyond the map edge flow in with their rivers and carve the main valley's trough and lakes (`glacial_inflow_balance`, m/yr, 0 = off). A coarser ice grid (`glacial_coarse_cell`) is about 3 times faster, with similar but not identical terrain. With `glacial_converged`, the ice settles to a steady state before it carves, conserving mass over cliffs.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Valley fill
features.what: sediment left after the ice fills glacial troughs to flat floors, while cirque lakes stay open.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Moraines
features.what: debris carried down the last glaciers builds ridges at their margins that dam lakes. Till draws as soil with stones through it, the stones kept above the grass.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Ice-worn rock
features.what: faces toward the old ice flow are smoothed, faces away are stepped, with striations.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Cliff ledges
features.what: rock beds of uneven thickness step faces steeper than 40 degrees into ledges.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Scree
features.what: rock walls shed aprons and cones at their feet, kept out of lakes and river floors. Scree draws as bare blocks; up close, each is an angular stone standing in a bed of gravel and fines.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Fallen blocks
features.what: blocks shed by cliffs rest below them, the largest furthest out.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: River deposition
features.what: rivers drop sediment where they slow (Yuan et al. 2019), building flat alluvial valley floors; solved exactly per step along the river tree, at about half the earlier cost.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Meandering rivers
features.what: bends grow and migrate across flat valley floors; cut-off loops leave oxbows that silt up, and the river water follows the new course.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Rivers fed by rain and snowmelt
features.what: a monthly water balance from the climate sets each river's flow, month by month.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: River network
features.what: rivers with widths and discharges, made into joined `PhysXRiver3D` paths.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: River sites
features.what: position, discharge, catchment, drop and run along every river, for placing lakes and falls.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Waterfall records
features.what: each fall's type, lip, face profiles, tiers, power, impact speed and plunge pool, for water effects.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Plunge pools and gorges
features.what: falls of 4 m or more scour a pool that holds water, and lips over hard rock wear back upstream into slot gorges.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Spray map
features.what: where fall spray keeps the ground wet, from each fall's power and distance.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Coast and lakes
features.what: sea with a Dean-profile seabed and beaches; lakes behind natural dams or rock lips that spill as waterfalls; builds the sea and lake surfaces, and rivers end in them.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Coastal dunes
features.what: beaches feed wind-blown sand inland; marram builds foredunes along the plant line, and blowouts and parabolic dunes open where the cover fails.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Sand seas
features.what: a desert area fills with wind-built transverse, linear, star or barchan dunes that bank against the hills, thin out at their edges and stop at rivers; each has a long gentle windward slope and a steep slip face at the angle of repose.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Geology maps
features.what: soil, bare rock and scree from the erosion run.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Climate maps
features.what: temperature, orographic rain and rain shadows, snow share, aridity, winter and annual sunlight with terrain shadows, and wind exposure.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Terrain data maps
features.what: bakes slope, curvature, water flow, wetness, water depth and distance to water around a point, for placing plants and for materials; a 512 map bakes once in about 0.2 s.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Ground material
features.what: rock, scree, soil, alluvium and sand from the generator's geology, height-blended, biplanar cliffs, erosion detail, wetness and snow.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Sky occlusion
features.what: raster ground is lit only by the sky its hills leave open, from a horizon bake and the live sky, matching path tracing at dusk.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Rock detail
features.what: steep rock shows bedding planes and breaks into irregular jointed blocks, and scree and till show loose stones that stand out of the gravel in parallax with their own shadows, also path traced; no textures and no stretching on any face.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Cliff relief
features.what: steep faces near the camera are refined without cracks and displaced into real bed ledges and joint blocks, path traced too. In raster, ledges shadow each other per pixel where the shadow map is too coarse (TerrainMaterial3D `cliff_self_shadow`).
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Far blend
features.what: far ground takes the colour of the plant cover map. With `far_start_from_vegetation` the blend starts where the streamed plants end, else at `far_start`.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Landscape3D
features.what: heightfield ground from a TerrainGenerator3D or a height image, as chunk meshes with crack-free LODs and one BLAS per chunk level, so nothing rebuilds while the camera moves. Heights stream in coarse first and chunk meshes build on worker threads (`stream_heights`); baked heights load 4 km at 1 m in under a second.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Landscape3D collision
features.what: full-detail heightfield tiles follow the player and match the drawn triangles.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Footprints in ground
features.what: prints in sand, soil, mud and leaf litter; moisture from the weather map, walls slump to the angle of repose. The prints simulate on the GPU (`gpu_simulation`). Within 8 m of the camera a 1.6 cm field (`near_field`) keeps print rims and lips crisp and matches the ground beyond its edge; boot prints show heel, toe and tread, and wet ground carries on past the deform patch.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Soft ground
features.what: vehicles sink into soft ground, print ruts and feel its grip and resistance (Bekker-Wong); tyres aired down sink less in sand; bodies sliding through sand slow as they plough it; `get_footing_at()` gives walkers effort, speed and slide.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Deep mud
features.what: wet ground, painted or wherever water gathers, gets a soft clay layer that flows as a Bingham fluid (O'Brien and Julien), holds ruts when stiff and lets a car sink to its axles as slurry.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Tyre clogging
features.what: sticky clay packs the tread until it grips like a slick, and spinning throws it off.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Belly drag
features.what: a car sunk past its clearance rides on its belly, is dragged by the soil and can high-centre.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Mud on vehicles
features.what: tyres, arches and bellies cake with the clay they drive through, in the ground's own clay colour, wet at first and drying pale.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Mud spray
features.what: spinning wheels fling clods of wet clay that land back in the ground.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Mud splats
features.what: clods that hit a vehicle stick as domed splats that drip, dry and wash off in water.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Muddy water
features.what: tyres and boots churn clay into standing water, which turns milky brown, drifts with the flow and settles out over minutes; tyre spray flies brown and stains the wheel arches.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Tracked mud
features.what: tyres and boots leaving clay lay a film of mud on firm ground that fades as they clean and dries pale in place.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Ruts that stay
features.what: prints, ruts and puddles are saved per tile as the ground streams out and are still there on return, in the same session or the next.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Mud on legs
features.what: each leg is coated to the depth its foot sank and flecked by the stride; the mud dries over minutes and rinses off in standing water.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Standing water
features.what: rain the ground cannot take and ground water gather level in ruts and prints, then soak in and dry, as real geometry in raster and path tracing.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Desiccation cracks
features.what: soaked clay dries to a pale matte crust that cracks into plates; rain closes the cracks, and each wet-dry cycle makes the pattern more regular.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Thrown sand
features.what: spinning wheels and kicks throw sand that flies and lands back in the ground as fans, with the volume kept; a drifting car throws sand out of the turn, heaps a berm on the outside and scuffs a wide track, and the sand pushes back on the sliding tyre.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Wind ripples
features.what: the wind grows ripples about 11 cm apart on dry sand, as geometry in raster and path tracing near the camera and as surface detail beyond it; prints wipe them and they form again.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Blowing sand
features.what: grains hop over dry sand as densely as the wind carries it, in streamers near the threshold wind.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Dust
features.what: the wind lifts dust off dry sand, and sliding tyres lift billowing clouds of it, carried on the wind until it settles; needs volumetric fog.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Sand glints
features.what: up close, dry sand shows the colours of its grains and the odd grain flashing in the sun.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Wet sand
features.what: water fills the pores of sand below it and drains after, darkening and glossing it, drying back up the beach; damp sand holds steep walls; water faster than the Shields threshold rounds off prints as bed load, keeping the sand volume.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Swash marks
features.what: each wave leaves a scalloped line of dark fine sand at its highest reach, and higher waves smooth older lines.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Runoff channels
features.what: water seeping out of a beach after the tide, and rain the ground cannot take, cuts a braided net of rills and lays the sand down at their foot.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Terrain deformation
features.what: non-destructive height brushes (rivers, craters, plots) over Terrain3D or a height map; moving a brush restores the ground.
features.title: Terrain

features.name: Rock generator
features.what: rocks and stones as real geometry, broken along each rock type's joints, rounded by transport and weathered by rock type; joint sets at varying angles, stepped fracture faces and broken corners on fallen blocks; granite, limestone, sandstone, basalt and slate.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Tafoni
features.what: salt weathering carves honeycomb hollows and tafoni into coastal and dry inland stone.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Close-up detail
features.what: stones near the camera get real geometry for their grain: crystals whose cleavage faces glint in low sun, weathering pits, hairline cracks, spalled flakes and stepped fresh breaks, so the outline breaks too.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Mineral glints
features.what: glossy crystals in granite and other quartz-bearing rock keep sparkling at a distance, counted per pixel footprint, and lichen, moss, water, snow and dust cover them.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Ground contact and aspect
features.what: stones sit in the soil, with damp, gritty ground and fines banked uphill round each foot; the foot blends into the ground with a soil band, or takes the ground's own grain with a damp, darker foot (the landscape's TerrainMaterial3D when `ground_material` is unset), and stones take wetness and snow from the weather; moss grows on shaded faces and lichen on sunlit ones.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Moss cushions
features.what: on near stones, moss grows as real cushions 1 to 3.5 cm thick, with tufts that hold up under path tracing.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Rock fields
features.what: rocks placed by the processes that put them there: rockfall, scree, glacial till, river beds, shores and cliff courses, streamed round the camera with colliders near it.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Breakable stones
features.what: stones split into pieces along rough rock breaks, and layered rock into slabs.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Live rockfall
features.what: cliff blocks fall in frost, thaw and rain, and break on impact.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Rockfall dust
features.what: falling and breaking stones throw up dust where they hit.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Tors and coasts
features.what: tors and outcrops on convex crests, with granite woolsack blocks and weathering pans; sea stacks, arches and wave-cut platforms on rocky coasts, with a wet barnacle and weed band below high water and a dark splash band above.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Landforms
features.what: hoodoo rows on bare soft slopes, limestone pavement on flat limestone benches, rows of sandstone fins on gentle bare sandstone, about half pierced by an arch, clusters of rounded sandstone knobs (goblins) on flat bare sandstone, and bedrock slabs drilled with potholes, grinder stones inside, on steep stream reaches.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Caves
features.what: cave networks grow behind limestone cliff-foot entrances (Paris 2021) and are meshed into the hillside around the opening, also on Terrain3D; stalactites, stalagmites and columns grow where water drips through the roof, and flow scallops the walls; streams run over washed, wet gravel beds. Sea caves follow cracks into sea cliffs, flooded at the mouth, some ending in a chamber with a blowhole to the cliff top.
features.title: Rocks

features.name: Shadows on water
features.what: rivers, lakes and the sea take shadows from terrain, objects and clouds in raster, as they already do under path tracing, on the surface and inside the water, seen from above or below. The open sea's raster colour matches the path tracer's. At a low sun, waves shade their own lee sides (`wave_shadows`).
features.title: Water

features.name: Refraction
features.what: water and glass blocks bend light by their IOR, with total internal reflection and depth tint; glTF `KHR_materials_volume`, `KHR_materials_ior`.
features.title: Water

features.name: Two-layer refraction
features.what: in raster, water and glass refract the water or glass behind them, so a pool shows through a falling stream.
features.title: Water

features.name: Murky water
features.what: scattering media; `IOR`, `ABSORPTION` and `SCATTERING` in shaders; glTF `KHR_materials_scatter` draft.
features.title: Water

features.name: Caustics
features.what: sunlight lines under rippled water. In raster, sunlight focused by the waves moves over the bed under clear water, following the scene's sun.
features.title: Water

features.name: Caustic cascades
features.what: sun caustics out to 256 m, near lines unchanged.
features.title: Water

features.name: Clear water
features.what: in raster, as under path tracing, the bed shows through the shallows of sea, lakes and rivers, refracted, and fades with depth.
features.title: Water

features.name: Path-traced ocean
features.what: waves refract, tint and scatter, with caustics on the seabed.
features.title: Water

features.name: Ocean swell
features.what: up to four wave layers give long swell under the chop without visible tiling, whitecaps where they add up, on a shallow-water (TMA) spectrum; set `depth` to the real depth for open sea (the 3 m default damps long waves).
features.title: Water

features.name: Measured wave spreading
features.what: Donelan-Banner spreading as Horvath (2015) fits it, with swell; slopes at 14 m/s match Cox and Munk's measurements.
features.title: Water

features.name: Whitecaps by wind speed
features.what: whitecap cover follows the wind speed as measured at sea (Monahan 1980), whatever the wave settings.
features.title: Water

features.name: Storm seas
features.what: above 9 m/s of wind, breaking crests throw puffs of spume downwind; above 14 m/s, gale foam lies in thin broken streaks along the wind.
features.title: Water

features.name: Torn spray sheets
features.what: in a gale the wind tears thin sheets of water off folding crests, in raster and path tracing.
features.title: Water

features.name: Crisp sea foam
features.what: sharp patch edges, torn lobed holes and bubble relief, up close and at range; distant foam keeps its lace in raster instead of turning to flat white sheets.
features.title: Water

features.name: Crest glow
features.what: low sun shines through a thin line along the high crest tops in the water's own colour, scaled to the sea's chop, in raster; path tracing already scatters through them.
features.title: Water

features.name: Spilling rollers
features.what: breaking crests carry a raised, churning roller of white water.
features.title: Water

features.name: Ocean detail
features.what: short ripples down to 8 cm; on every wave cascade, waves smaller than a pixel pass into the surface roughness, so near and far sun glitter keeps the right width, and the far sea mirrors the sky through their mean Fresnel instead of turning into a pale sheet; whitecaps age into lace with bubble grain, and a turquoise bubble plume glows under fresh foam.
features.title: Water

features.name: Lake ripples
features.what: on short fetches the wave grid gets finer, up to 256 points, so lakes keep their short wind ripples and sun glitter; open sea is unchanged.
features.title: Water

features.name: Cave pools
features.what: pool water under a cave roof measures the real floor beneath it, so a shallow pool thins out to its rim.
features.title: Water

features.name: Underground reflections
features.what: with `raster_reflections` off, still water and streams mirror the cave around them in raster; rivers keep clear water.
features.title: Water

features.name: Raster reflections
features.what: raster sea and rivers reflect the sky and the sun's glitter by the exact Fresnel term, matching the path tracer, and omni and spot lights glint on all raster water; raster waterfalls, white water, sea foam and wet sand take the scene's shadows, sky light and cloud shadows; the water's own colour is lit by sun and sky, so the sea darkens at dusk.
features.title: Water

features.name: Boat wakes
features.what: waves stepped with deep-water dispersion in Fourier space form the Kelvin pattern, a 19.5 degree wedge of transverse and diverging waves.
features.title: Water

features.name: Shore waves
features.what: swell turns with the seabed, grows in the shallows, breaks and runs up the sand (Stockdon run-up); lakes get shore waves from their own wind only.
features.title: Water

features.name: Wave groups
features.what: shore waves arrive in sets with their own Rayleigh heights, so each breaks at its own place.
features.title: Water

features.name: Plunging breakers
features.what: the crest throws a sheet of water that lands ahead and sinks into the bore, with spray where it is thin and where it lands.
features.title: Water

features.name: Shore wetness
features.what: sand, rocks and plants stay wet up to where the waves ran or the river reached, and dry with the weather.
features.title: Water

features.name: Rock contact foam
features.what: white water rings where the sea meets stacks, boulders and cliff feet, widening as each wave arrives, and washes over rock tops just under the surface.
features.title: Water

features.name: Currents
features.what: flow round rocks and along shores carries waves, foam and floating objects.
features.title: Water

features.name: Live flow
features.what: near the player, rocks and banks shed wakes and eddies. Splashes and wakes near the camera wash up beaches and banks and drain back.
features.title: Water

features.name: Live water
features.what: water from springs, rain or a breaking dam runs downhill over any ground, fills hollows and floods. The live area follows the camera; water left behind stays in place and flows again on return.
features.title: Water

features.name: Buoyancy from shapes
features.what: bodies take their volume from their collision shapes and their mass from per-shape densities, so wood, ice and steel hulls float at their real drafts.
features.title: Water

features.name: Bodies push water
features.what: legs, hulls and props push live water, seas and rivers aside as they move, heaping water ahead and leaving a wake behind.
features.title: Water

features.name: White water
features.what: foam in fast water, trailing rocks and drifting downstream.
features.title: Water

features.name: Rivers
features.what: drawn as a curve; finds its depth and never runs uphill.
features.title: Water

features.name: Contact waterfalls
features.what: water that clings to steep rock, as wide as its flow, clear at the lip and white below the inception point, with soft wandering edges, wet rock beside it and spray off ledges. Thin falls over stepped rock run ledge to ledge as threads with wet rock between them, as their flow sets (`rock_step`); big flows stay fully covered. The sheets follow cliff relief ledge by ledge.
features.title: Water

features.name: Plunging waterfalls
features.what: tall falls break up into a falling column of clumps slowed by the air, inside a spray veil and soft mist; where the face leans into the jet, the fall keeps to the rock and fans out down it.
features.title: Water

features.name: Faster flow bakes
features.what: multigrid-preconditioned conjugate gradients bake the flow 7 to 10 times faster than SOR.
features.title: Water

features.name: Camera under water
features.what: fog, scattering, Snell's window, image split at the water line. In raster, omni and spot lights glow and scatter in the water, as under path tracing.
features.title: Water

features.name: Plant placement
features.what: places species by spacing, footprint and rules on slope, wetness and distance to water over a `TerrainDataMap3D`; evenly spread, the same for a seed. 12,899 plants over 256 m place once in about 45 ms, then draw as ordinary MultiMeshes.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Streamed placement
features.what: tiles are placed on worker threads around the camera, identical to a full placement; 2 to 3 ms of main-thread time a frame through 1 km of oak wood.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Placement by geology
features.what: plants follow the generated soil, rock and scree; trees stay off bare rock and thin soil, grass thins on rock.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Placement by climate
features.what: species by temperature, winter frost, rain, aridity and sunlight.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Density masks
features.what: a painted texture thins or clears any species per channel, for clearings and paths.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Worn paths
features.what: along paths, plants and grass thin out and shorten by how well they resist trampling, leaving bare trodden soil.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Cereal crops
features.what: wheat, barley, oats and rye as real plants in drill rows, with spikelet ears and barley awns, through their growth stages from green rows to gold ears and stubble with straw swaths.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Crop fields
features.what: field outlines with their own drill direction, sowing date, tramlines and headland; the ground carries the crop's colour into the distance.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Hedgerows and margins
features.what: field edges carry hedgerows of mixed native shrubs with a gateway per field, and headland and verge strips of field weeds.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Clear of boulders
features.what: grass, ground plants, tree feet and fallen logs keep out of boulders.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Waterfall spray
features.what: plants keep out of the soaked ground in a waterfall's spray zone, where only mosses grow.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plant cover map
features.what: a colour map of the plant cover baked from the planting rules, for distant terrain.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Canopy shade
features.what: understorey placed by the shade of placed crowns; crowns feed the weather's canopy map.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Grass
features.what: blades grow round the camera in clumps, follow `TerrainDataMap3D` rules, thin with distance, bend in the `WeatherMap3D` wind (each blade answers gusts at its own frequency, about 2 Hz, and the sway rolls downwind as waves) and darken in rain; near tall grass at 120 blades per m²; the sward darkens inside from its leaf area (raster AO) and casts its blades' true shadow; path traced.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Grass on the GPU
features.what: grass tiles are filled in compute, about 40% less main-thread cost per tile.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Grass edge fade
features.what: blades thin and shrink across the outer band of the grass radius, and the ground takes their colour beyond (measured from a render of the blades, so any grass look matches), so the grass has no hard edge; it thins evenly with distance by blue-noise blade ranks, with no clumps or gaps.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Far grass in sunlight
features.what: distant grass brightens looking away from the sun and darkens looking into it, measured from the blades at four sun headings.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Grass edge match
features.what: after each bake the ground past the grass is matched to the blades in view, so there is no brightness step where the blades end.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Grass under undergrowth
features.what: grass thins and shortens under bracken and bramble stands, as their shade kills the sward, and the stands lay their own litter beneath; thin margins keep their grass.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Seasonal grass
features.what: grass browns in drought and hard cold and stays green in a mild winter, read from the season.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Layered meadow
features.what: blades vary in colour over the field and per blade, some dead from the root, with midribs and tapered tips; the ground under the grass becomes matching turf, and the sward follows the canopy shade.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Trampling
features.what: bodies lay grass down and it springs back.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Ground cover
features.what: edge-on blades widened, ground tinted under grass, clover and flower drifts.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plant generator
features.what: meadow plants including tall flowers (knapweed, field scabious, wild carrot, common sorrel, some in seed), forest floor and wetland plants with seed variations, phyllotaxis, back-lit leaves with generated vein textures, and distance LODs that drop whole leaf cards and enlarge the rest to keep coverage (112k to 70k triangles on a heath), for `PlantSpecies.meshes`.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plants by season
features.what: 17 flowering herbs open, go to seed and die back to standing stalks by degree days; fern croziers unroll in spring, fronds die back russet and lie flat through winter, and wood anemone dies down after flowering.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Forest floor
features.what: herbs, mosses and seedlings by the stand above (seedlings of the stand's own trees, with their leaf forms; dog-violets and herb Robert in the lighter patches), and the ground under closed canopy turns to leaf, needle or moss litter.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Stand margins
features.what: bracken and bramble stands grow shorter and lean outward toward their edges.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Rock foot
features.what: ferns, mosses, wood sorrel and seedlings gather within about half a metre of a rock's foot.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plants on and between stones
features.what: moss grows on the tops of generated stones, green cushions on low, shaded tops and hoary yellow-olive ones on high, sunlit tops (`PlantSpecies.stone_top_damp`), and crevice ferns, stonecrop, saxifrage and thrift only in the gaps of scree, gravel and shingle.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plants on deadwood
features.what: ground plants keep off fallen logs, and moss, wood sorrel, seedlings and ferns grow on and along them.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Woodland mushrooms
features.what: fly agaric, cep, chanterelle, brittlegill, clouded agaric and honey fungus, with stalks, caps, gills or tubes, rings and warts, come up under their host trees from late summer to the first frost; honey fungus grows in clumps out of the side of deadwood, clouded agaric in fairy-ring arcs.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Leaf drift
features.what: fallen leaves drift past the crowns into edges and clearings, farther downwind.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Wetland plants
features.what: reed, bulrush, rush and water lilies zoned by water depth, lilies floating on the surface.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Waterside plants
features.what: marsh marigold, meadowsweet and butterbur line streams, lakes and falls by distance to water; river stones carry river moss and liverwort by height over the water, the moss trailing downstream.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Bog plants
features.what: sphagnum hummocks, cotton grass, bog asphodel and sundew on wet level ground.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Atlantic heath
features.what: bell heather, cross-leaved heath and crowberry in dry, wet and cliff-top heath, placed by rain, winter cold and wetness.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Mediterranean scrub
features.what: rosemary, French lavender, thyme and sage-leaved rockrose, as garrigue on thin soil and maquis on deeper soil where winters are mild and summers dry; the rockrose folds and greys its leaves in drought.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Dune plants
features.what: marram, lyme grass and sea holly on sand; they shelter it from the wind, so blowing sand piles into mounds round them.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Salt marsh and shingle plants
features.what: glasswort, cord-grass, sea purslane, sea aster and sea lavender zoned by height above the tide on sheltered marsh; sea kale, sea campion and horned-poppy on shingle backshores.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Alpine and scree plants
features.what: fellfield, alpine grassland, snowbed and scree sets above the treeline, placed by climate, curvature, sunlight, soil depth and talus.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Leaf wear
features.what: insect bites, uneven halves, dead tips and older leaves yellowing and browning, per leaf.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Bending
features.what: plants bend away from bodies and spring back, and lean in the wind.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Ground mist
features.what: at dawn, low mist pools in hollows and drifts through the grass, set by the weather and sun; bodies part it, and it burns off as the sun climbs.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Pollen puffs
features.what: brushing grasses and other wind-pollinated plants in flower releases a puff of pollen; each plant recharges, and wet plants stay still.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Sun and shade growth
features.what: grass and ground plants take the colour and height of the light they grow in, like sun and shade leaves.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Per-stem sway
features.what: each frond, cane and stem rocks about its own base at a frequency set by its height and stiffness.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Near and far meshes
features.what: heavier meshes near the camera, crossfaded with dithering a few plants at a time.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Far thinning
features.what: plants thin out one by one in blue-noise order with distance and leave their colour on the ground beyond, with no tile pops.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Far plants as volume
features.what: past their range, plants keep a porous voxel shell of their leaf cover out to 150 m.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Plant impostors
features.what: large plants turn into octahedral impostors past a range in raster (brambles and bracken past 15 m), while path tracing keeps the meshes; an oak wood view drops from 3.91M to 2.98M triangles.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: GPU-placed instances
features.what: MultiMesh records written by a compute shader reach culling, motion vectors and path tracing.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Instance bones
features.what: each instance is skinned from its own records, so thousands of plants bend in the wind without a Skeleton3D each; raster and path traced. 900 swaying stems: 0.30 ms render CPU, against 5.97 ms as 900 Skeleton3D.
features.title: Vegetation

features.name: Tree generator
features.what: trees and woody shrubs grow bud by bud, competing for light, so the same settings always give the same tree. 31 species from Europe and eastern North America, each with its climate, slope and soil habitat (`apply_habitat`).
features.title: Trees

features.name: Stand and open forms
features.what: trees grown in a closed stand shed their lower limbs to a long clear bole under a narrow crown; open-grown trees keep leaves down to their lower limbs.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Conifer crowns
features.what: spruce, fir, larch, pine and hemlock keep their cone, with branches to the top.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Stands
features.what: thirteen stand types, from beech, oak-lime, riparian alder and subalpine larch to North American northern hardwood and pine-hemlock, plus managed coppice with standards, wood pasture and pollard rows (`STAND_COPPICE_STANDARDS`, `STAND_WOOD_PASTURE`, `STAND_POLLARD_ROW`). Each places canopy trees, trees in the gaps, saplings, shrubs under their shade and deadwood, and overlapping stands blend at their edges.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Pollards and coppice
features.what: trees cut back on a cycle regrow straight poles from a swollen, knobbly head or a ground stool; lapsed pollards carry big limbs. Poles swell into collars and carry branch scars; coppice stools end in old rotted cuts under a callus lip, and their rods swell at the nodes.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Shrubs and hedges
features.what: many-stemmed shrubs, drawn up and thin under a canopy; hedges and topiary clipped to a box.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Field hedges
features.what: hawthorn, blackthorn, hazel, field maple and dog rose as flailed 2 m hedge segments, with blossom and fruit in season.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Gorse and broom
features.what: real spines, flowers and pods, flowering by season, in young, mature, old, thicket and cushion forms.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Mediterranean shrubs
features.what: gum rockrose, kermes oak and lentisk, with flowers, acorns and drupes as geometry.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Dwarf fan palm
features.what: clumps of short fibrous trunks or stemless crowns, with pleated fan leaves on spiny stalks, a skirt of dead leaves, spring flower clusters and dates that ripen from green to red-brown.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Stone pine
features.what: an umbrella crown on a clear bole, cones in three ages and plated red-brown bark.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Mediterranean trees
features.what: holm oak and carob split low into dense domes, wild olive grows crooked stems from one stool, maritime pine runs onto a long clear bole, and cork oak carries thick cork plates or a stripped trunk that turns from orange to red-brown and darkens as new cork grows back.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Wind, bank and rock trees
features.what: at the tree line, windward limbs die back and the rest turn downwind, and krummholz grows as low domed cushions stretched downwind on layered stems under a skin of needled shoots, cut at the snow surface; the tree line follows the growing season's mean temperature, as the alpine plants do; trees on stream banks and gorge sides lean their roots downhill, with eroded roots arching off the face; roots can drape over a boulder beside the stem.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Clearings
features.what: painted clearings and paths keep trees and shrubs out.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Branch collars
features.what: branches flare into their parent in a short collar with a bark ridge in the crotch. Limbs that would grow into thicker wood bend away or die back to it.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Surface roots
features.what: buttress roots run out of the trunk flare, tapering as they sink into the soil, longer on shallow-rooted species.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Bark
features.what: a procedural bark per species from six families (smooth, furrowed, plated, scaly, flaking, papery), with displaced relief on near trunks for raster and path tracing. Smooth beech bark shows cross-stem creases, lenticel streaks and fine grain, and carries stemflow tracks, low algae and crust lichen.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Bark stories
features.what: frost ribs, lightning scars, deer stripping and resin runs on trunks; drying checks open as real splits and knots on lying logs.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Branch-scar chevrons
features.what: living beech and birch carry dark chevrons below shed limbs, longer and flatter with age, black on birch.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Bark moss
features.what: moss gathers at the foot of the stem and on the upper faces of limbs, thicker on rough bark and decayed wood, as real cushions with ragged margins near the camera.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Crown parts
features.what: cones, catkins with bract scales, ash keys in bunches, and rowan and elder berries in dense corymbs on branching stalks in season; winter buds on shoot tips; mistletoe on its hosts and witches' brooms as twig nests on birches.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Bark lichen
features.what: lichen on bark, placed by height, crown light, stem age and moss; beard lichens and oakmoss hang from and stand off crown twigs on near trees. 0 turns it off.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Climbers
features.what: ivy up the stem, clematis hanging from the limbs or honeysuckle twining round them, swaying with the tree. Old ivy has woody stems that thicken with the host's age and lie on the bark ridges, with unlobed adult leaves high on old stems.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Leaf shapes
features.what: simple, lobed, palmate and compound leaves per species, with the true outline as geometry; compound leaflets take a toothed, veined texture, and leaf undersides are paler.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Needles
features.what: real needles near the camera, crossed needle sprays beyond.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Near leaf detail
features.what: lobed and compound leaves are built for trees near the camera; further out each leaf is a simple leaf of the same area.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Seasons
features.what: leaves come out, turn and fall by species from the shared season state; larch turns gold and goes bare, evergreens stay.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Tree LODs
features.what: far levels drop thin wood and thin out leaves, enlarging the rest so leaf area holds; leaves stay geometry at every level. Far broadleaf meshes use the lighter leaf level, with about 60% fewer leaf vertices and the same path traced look at 60 m.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Old trees
features.what: basal hollows, rot holes, woodpecker holes, burls, epicormic shoots and snapped crowns on the clear bole, listed by `get_veteran_features()`.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Deadwood
features.what: standing dead trees, snapped tops, stumps and fallen logs in the five forestry decay classes. Bark comes away in plates by decay class, from the top of snags and the upper side of logs, baring grey or brown checked wood; peeled edges show the bark's thickness. Logs settle along the ground at every decay class, and fallen sticks lie as snapped, kinked pieces. Windthrown trees lie with their root plate on edge, its torn underside holding soil clods, stones and root stubs, the butt held off the ground.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Broken limbs
features.what: snapped ends get a splintered fracture face and torn bark; storms break limbs on living trees, leaving some hanging.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Fungi
features.what: bracket fungi and mushroom tufts with stalks, caps and gills grow as geometry on old and dead wood, by host and decay class.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Fallen branches
features.what: shed limbs and sticks on the forest floor, from the stand's own trees.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Tree wind
features.what: trees sway in the weather map's wind and gusts, each limb at its own frequency.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Storm damage
features.what: storm wind breaks limbs and throws trees by wood strength and root anchorage; they fall and break apart on landing.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Leaf flutter
features.what: leaves flutter and twist on their stalks in the same wind as grass and plants.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Far wind
features.what: trees move in the wind out to 1 km, with far ones posed less often and with fewer limbs.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Colliders and touch
features.what: trunks and limbs collide near the camera; characters and vehicles push branches aside, and fast bodies snap thin ones off.
features.title: Trees

features.name: Snow cover
features.what: a snowpack from the weather map, with snowfall, settling, melt, sliding off steep slopes and wind drift.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Snowpack on a worker thread
features.what: snowpack updates run off the main thread and swap in when done, so the frame never waits; main-thread share per update about 6 ms down to about 1 ms.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Snow climate
features.what: bakes a winter over the whole terrain from the terrain's climate recipe and precipitation map, with snow lines, shaded faces that keep their snow and loaded lee slopes; the cover carries it on with the weather and draws it far away.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Fine detail kept in the wide snow map
features.what: drifts, slides and melt worked out near the camera are written back to the wide snowpack, so they are still there when the camera leaves and returns.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Shelter
features.what: ground under roofs and overhangs stays bare; tree crowns hold snow and unload it later.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Wind moves lying snow
features.what: windward shoulders and crests are scoured and the lee fills with wind-packed snow.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Melt-freeze crusts
features.what: a thawed surface refreezes into a crust that hardens each cycle; boots break thin ones into tipped pieces and stand on hard ones.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Snow on materials
features.what: surfaces are covered from the snowpack, flattest facets first, raster and path traced; `get_snow_shader_code()` for ShaderMaterials.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Deep snow
features.what: deep snow as geometry with prints and tracks; bodies sink by weight (Bekker) and rest in their own tracks; tracks refill with new snow and wind; print edges stay clean at fine deform resolutions, with pushed-aside snow sliding at its repose angle.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Deep snow on the GPU
features.what: pressing, slumping and refilling run in compute shaders, main-thread cost 1.5 ms down to 0.04 ms with the same prints; the CPU path stays for Compatibility.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Bow wave
features.what: fast bodies push the rim ahead (full at 4 m/s), leaving side berms and an end mound, mass kept; snow and ground.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Falling snow
features.what: falling and blowing snow from the weather; flake counts, sizes and fall speeds from snowfall measurements, drawn as motion streaks; roofs shelter, snow blows above the wind threshold, `get_extinction()` feeds fog.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Snowstorms
features.what: falling and blowing snow haze the air through the weather map (Pomeroy-Male suspension, 118 m visibility at 20 m/s); flakes ride turbulent eddies.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Cornices
features.what: overhangs on lee crests, with collision; milder ranges grow them too (crest wind speed-up).
features.title: Snow

features.name: Cornices crack and fall
features.what: a creeping tension crack, tumbling blocks, debris below.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Icicles
features.what: grown from roof melt water below freezing; clear ice with a hazy core.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Sparkle
features.what: dry snow glints from ice grains (its own mirror lobe, raster and path traced), lost when wet.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Exact path traced sparkle
features.what: every 2 mm ice grain is a facet hit per ray.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Sparkle in path traced reflections
features.what: snow seen in a mirror, water or a window glints too, sized by each ray's cone, and light bounced off snow carries its glints.
features.title: Snow

features.name: Weather map
features.what: one weather state round the camera (wind, cloud cover, rain, wetness, puddles), read by every shader through global uniforms, raster and path traced.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Wind
features.what: slows near the ground (`roughness_length`); gusts follow the measured spectrum and travel with the wind.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Wind near the ground
features.what: shelter inside plant canopies and behind buildings; gust patches sweep across fields.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Season state
features.what: day length, budburst and leaf-colour sums, snow line, soil frost and moisture from the date and climate, for every system.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Storms
features.what: drift with the wind, with a rain core and a downdraft.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Lightning and thunder
features.what: strikes from storm cells at a rate set by cloud-top height, lit by their own channel under path tracing, with sharp shadows in raster too (`raster_shadow_distance`) and thunder made from the channel.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Precipitation haze
features.what: snow and rain haze the air in raster fog and the path traced medium; blowing snow is a lit layer near the ground.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Haze and cloud shadow in fog
features.what: volumetric fog takes the cloud shadow, and the weather adds haze from visibility and humidity.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Shafts across the sky
features.what: the air under the clouds reads a baked cloud shadow map, so light shafts reach across the whole sky, and the weather's haze carries on past the volumetric fog.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Path traced haze
features.what: under path tracing the haze is a traced medium lit through shadows and the clouds' direct beam, so shafts stay sharp at any distance and show in reflections.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Wet surfaces and puddles
features.what: fill with rain and dry by evaporation; materials with Wetness on darken and gloss up.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Contact wetness
features.what: ground that running water crossed stays dark after it drains, then dries with the weather.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Rain on rock
features.what: rivulets run down rock faces while it rains, and the rock dries in patches after.
features.title: Weather

features.name: Followers
features.what: water waves grow with the weather's wind (`follow_weather`); cloth and hair move in it (`weather_wind`).
features.title: Weather

features.name: Sun and moon clock
features.what: date, time and place point the sun and moon lights, with moon phases (Meeus); the sun is within 0.0004 degrees of the ephemeris and sunrise within half a minute of the almanac (`docs/bench/sky --test`).
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Sky atmosphere
features.what: multiple scattering (Hillaire 2020) lit by sun and moon, with twilight, the Earth's shadow and clouds hazed to the horizon; `atmo_far_water` hazes far sea, `energy_per_lux` scales the lights.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Night sky
features.what: the 9,100 naked-eye stars of the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, placed by the sky clock, coloured by temperature, dimmed by the air and hidden behind clouds, with glare on the brightest; the moon disc shows its real phase and earthshine; on moonless nights the faint green airglow of the upper air brightens toward the horizon and lights cloud tops; the Milky Way comes from a galactic panorama turned with the stars.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Eye adaptation
features.what: exposure follows the light on the ground like an adapting eye, so twilight, moonlit and starlit scenes stay readable.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Night vision
features.what: in dim light colour fades to the eye's blue-grey night vision (Purkinje shift) while lamps, lit windows and the moon keep theirs, from the scene's real luminance, in raster and path tracing.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Cloud layer
features.what: shaped from the weather map's cover, cloud type and storms; drawn by `WeatherSkyMaterial` and seen by path traced rays (`pathtracing_sky_shader_enabled`).
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Clouds that never repeat
features.what: shape noise read at two scales with an irrational ratio.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Evolving clouds
features.what: clouds form, clear and reshape over time instead of only drifting.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Cloud reprojection
features.what: clouds draw a sixteenth of their pixels each frame and reproject the rest (Nubis), still full resolution.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Cloud shadows
features.what: the clouds' shadow is baked into the sun's projector, matching in raster and path tracing.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Sun projector
features.what: `light_projector` works on DirectionalLight3D (`projector_size`, `projector_offset`), raster and path traced.
features.title: Sky and clouds

features.name: Lit smoke in raster
features.what: smoke takes sky and ambient light and the sun through scene shadows, and shadows the scene; `scattering_temporal` removes step banding at its edges.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Smoke on the ground
features.what: Flow gas rests on the terrain and slides downhill, and heavier-than-air smoke pools as dust or fog.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Gas pushes bodies
features.what: Flow smoke, blasts and fire updrafts blow debris, Blast pieces, flags and tarps, and the cloth stirs the gas back.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Spreading fire
features.what: grass and leaf litter catch and burn at Rothermel's rate of spread, faster downwind and uphill and stopped by wet fuel, behind a glowing front with Flow flames and smoke. The fire leaves a ragged burn scar: grass burns to charred stubble with glowing tips, small plants and crops char, tree bark chars to the flame length and leaves brown up to the scorch height.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Fuel moisture from the weather
features.what: fuel dries or damps toward the air's equilibrium moisture, and rain wets it, slows the fire and puts it out.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Burning objects
features.what: wooden props catch fire from burning ground nearby, char with glowing cracks, smoulder in rain and throw embers that start new fires.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Burning logs
features.what: fallen logs and branches catch from the fire under them, flame for minutes, then smoulder with glowing bark.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Fire light and embers
features.what: a burning Flow emitter lights its surroundings with a soft-shadowed light that flickers with the flame's puffing, and throws up glowing embers, in raster and path tracing.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Particle fluid surface
features.what: particle fluids draw as clear water on a real isosurface mesh that casts shadows, shows in reflections and is path traced; Screen Space is the lighter alternative. Spray falls as clear drops, and foam and bubbles form only where water strikes water, so a smooth pour stays clear.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Cloth tearing
features.what: overstretched edges split and the rip runs.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Burning cloth
features.what: cloth catches fire, chars with a glowing edge and burns through in holes until it falls apart.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Blast materials
features.what: pieces carry several materials and each bond its own strength, so a limb breaks into bark, wood and leaves, and a twig joint gives before a trunk joint.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Blast without stalls
features.what: piece meshes are built once per asset, off the main thread, so a large break does not stall the frame; destructibles can start already moving.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Streaming without stalls
features.what: static bodies of streamed regions enter over a few frames, nearest first, and removals are batched; bodies with the same friction and bounce share one material, so the cost stays flat as the world grows.
features.title: Physics (PhysX 5)

features.name: Fibre shading
features.what: Chiang hair model under path tracing, melanin colour, on shells, cards and strands; mask for single-material characters.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Raster hair shading
features.what: Marschner model as Unreal evaluates it, with multiple scattering and light through the strands in shadow maps, so backlit hair glows.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Deep opacity shadows
features.what: raster strands shadow themselves in depth, calibrated against the path tracer; omni and spot lights too (`deep_shadow_local_lights`).
features.title: Hair

features.name: Hair shadows
features.what: raster strand hair casts shadows on the face, body and ground.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Custom hair shaders
features.what: `HAIR`, `HAIR_ABSORPTION`, `HAIR_ROUGHNESS` and `POSITIONAL_SHADOW_OFFSET` outputs; `hair_strands` and `hair_cards` render modes; `IN_PATH_TRACER` built-in.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Strand grooms
features.what: grown on a scalp mesh or loaded from a HAIR file.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Moving strand hair
features.what: AMD TressFX's simulation on GPU compute, guide and follow strands, velocity shock propagation, wind with gusts and turbulence, collision spheres.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Swept sphere strands
features.what: where the GPU traces swept spheres in hardware, strands are traced as round tubes, one primitive per segment, and shaded where the ray meets the fibre; other GPUs keep crossed strips. Not yet checked on supporting hardware.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Raster strands
features.what: blended and sorted far to near on the GPU each frame; smooth without TAA or MSAA, and the hair shadows itself.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Distance LOD
features.what: far away, fewer and wider strands with the same look; simulation and path tracing keep every strand. Straight hair is drawn through fewer points with the same look (`simplify_tolerance`).
features.title: Hair

features.name: Far hair for crowds
features.what: far strand hair hands over to one thick strand per clump, a clump at a time once it is 2 pixels across, simulating only the guides once the whole head has handed over. Raster only; path tracing keeps the strands.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Motion vectors for strands
features.what: TAA, FSR 2 and DLSS follow moving hair instead of smearing it; shaders get `PREVIOUS_FRAME` and `render_mode alpha_motion_vectors`.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Wet hair
features.what: strands soak in rain and dry over time, turning darker, glossier, heavier, flatter and clumped.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Snow on hair
features.what: snow from the weather settles on the top layer and windward side as small clumps, on strands and hair cards alike, and melts into wetness.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Grey and sun-bleached hair
features.what: single grey strands mixed through the hair, and lengths lighter and warmer toward the tips.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Body collision
features.what: strands collide with a body mesh, skinned or not, through a distance field built on the GPU every frame.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Hair on cloth
features.what: strands rest on simulated cloth such as a collar or hood, lying over it as it moves.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Strand-strand collision
features.what: guide strands no longer pass through each other, with friction.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Hair volume
features.what: strands push and drag on each other through a density grid, so hair keeps its volume.
features.title: Hair

features.name: Camera-relative tracing
features.what: exact shadows and reflections far from the origin.

features.name: Off-screen culling
features.what: small or distant unseen objects leave the trace.
